name: Quarrel
overview: Scripture reveals that quarrels arise from anger and foolishness, with Proverbs emphasizing the danger of stirring up strife and the wisdom of being slow to anger to maintain peace. Quarrels often begin subtly, like water being released, and must be avoided before they escalate. The Bible honors those who cease from contention and warns against meddling in disputes that do not belong to us, comparing such interference to grabbing a dog by the ears. Furthermore, strife is sustained by gossip and talebearing, but without these fuels, conflicts will naturally die out.
